title: Electricity invoice (Portugal), read for ESG
description: What is read from an electricity invoice. Financial part follows EN 16931 (business terms BT-n in each description); supply and consumption follow the content ERSE requires on Portuguese invoices; the ESG part is the activity data for Scope 2 (GHG Protocol, location-based and market-based). Each read field may carry a confidence (0-1) in 'confianca'.

nome.description: Seller name (BT-27). For example EDP Comercial, Endesa, Iberdrola, Galp, Goldenergy.

cliente.description: Buyer (EN 16931 BG-7): the group company the invoice is for.

nif.description: Buyer VAT identifier (BT-48). Used to find the company of the group.

numero_cliente.description: Customer account number at the supplier.

fatura.description: Invoice identification (EN 16931 BG-0 / BT-1 to BT-3).

tipo.description: Invoice type (BT-3). 'acerto' corrects earlier estimated readings; 'estimativa' is billed on estimated readings.

fornecimento.description: Supply point and contract (content required by ERSE on Portuguese invoices).

cpe.description: Delivery point code (Código de Ponto de Entrega), 20 characters, for example PT0002000012345678AB. One per meter: the site of the company.

nivel_tensao.description: Voltage level: low normal, low special, medium, high, very high.

potencia_contratada_kva.description: Contracted power in kVA (BTN) or kW.

periodo_fim.description: End of the billing period (BT-74). When the period crosses two quarters, the kWh are split by days.

tipo_leitura.description: Real meter reading, estimated, or smart meter.

consumo.description: Energy consumed in the period: the activity data for Scope 2.

energia_ativa_kwh.description: Total active energy in kWh. Goes to E01 Consumo de eletricidade (converted to MWh).

por_periodo_horario.description: Active energy by time-of-use period, when the invoice splits it.

injecao_rede_kwh.description: Energy fed into the grid, when shown.

rotulagem.description: Energy label that Portuguese suppliers show on the invoice (source mix and emissions of the supplier). Basis for market-based Scope 2.

renovavel_pct.description: Share of renewable sources in the supplier mix. Goes to E03 Eletricidade de fontes renováveis.

mix.description: Source mix as printed (hydro, wind, solar, natural gas, coal, nuclear, cogeneration, other).

emissoes_gco2_kwh.description: CO2 emissions of the supplier mix in g/kWh. Market-based emission factor.

emissoes_kg_co2.description: CO2 footprint of this invoice in kg, when the supplier prints it (for example 'Pegada ecologica CO2: 32.57 kg'). Without the mix factor, emissoes_gco2_kwh is derived from it.

residuos_radioativos_ug_kwh.description: Radioactive waste in µg/kWh, as printed.

garantias_origem.description: True when the contract is 100% renewable with guarantees of origin (market-based factor 0).

valores.description: Financial totals (EN 16931 BG-22) and the main charges.

redes_eur.description: Network access charges (tarifas de acesso às redes).

iva.description: VAT breakdown by rate (BG-23); electricity in Portugal has 6% and 23% parts.

custo_medio_eur_kwh.description: Calculated: total without VAT / active energy kWh.

linhas.description: Invoice lines as printed (EN 16931 BG-25), for traceability.

esg.description: What the platform does with the invoice: calculated after reading, confirmed by the user.

indicadores.description: Values that go to indicators of the platform.

E03.description: Eletricidade de fontes renováveis, % = rotulagem.renovavel_pct (weighted by kWh across invoices).

E07.description: Emissões indiretas de GHG (Âmbito 2), kgCO2e: location-based with the grid factor of the library, or market-based with rotulagem.emissoes_gco2_kwh.

reparticao_periodos.description: kWh by reporting period when the billing period crosses two of them (pro rata by days).

metodo.description: Text of a digital PDF, OCR of a scan or photo, typed by hand, or a cloud service.

confianca.description: Confidence 0-1 per field path, for example {"consumo.energia_ativa_kwh": 0.97}.

ficheiro_fid.description: Id of the stored invoice file (evidence).
